prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic portrait of a clearly adult blonde woman standing against a bedroom villa tile wall at night. She has straight blonde hair center-parted and falling past her shoulders, glossy pink lips, defined brows, soft glam makeup, a curvy figure, and a confident relaxed expression. She wears a beige crochet one-shoulder cutout top with silk details and a matching crochet skirt, styled as a tasteful fashion look with coverage maintained, plus gold bangles on both wrists and a small navel piercing. Pose her naturally with one hand on the hip. Use direct on-camera flash with nighttime ambient background, high contrast, sharp highlights on crochet, silk, jewelry, and hair, a textured stone wall, an 85mm lens at f/2.0, ISO 200, 4k 2:3 framing, natural skin texture, and subtle film grain.
